Application Data.NAME: Ace Hardware Store
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: The Ace Hardware Store specializes in providing high-quality hardware, tools, home improvement products, and building materials to both DIY enthusiasts and professional contractors. Our extensive inventory includes paint, plumbing supplies, electrical products, lawn and garden equipment, and seasonal items. We also offer services such as tool rental, key cutting, and expert advice to assist customers in their home improvement projects. Our knowledgeable staff is dedicated to delivering exceptional customer service and ensuring a positive shopping experience for all our clients.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses occurred on 03/12/2023 due to a plumbing supply leak, resulting in $5,000 in damage; status: resolved. Additionally, a theft incident on 07/22/2023 led to a loss of $5,000; status: under investigation.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Chain link fencing with security lighting and patrolling watchpersons during closing hours.

I was impressed by the helpful staff at this hardware store who guided me through my renovation projects, despite the occasional hiccup in inventory caused by the unique challenges of their older building.

Their tools and materials turned out to be perfect for my renovation, proving that with the right advice, even older homes can shine again!
